top_signal.title: 36 years old, have experience in multiple fields, but feel completely stuck professionally. Has anyone been through this?
top_signal.summary: I'm 36 years old, and for the past 10 years I've been working as a self-employed accountant, basically taking over the family accounting business from my father.   For the last 2 years, I've also been working as an external consultant for a company involved in European research projects related to AI and Data.   I studied Economics and Business and have a Master's degree in Machine Learning. I'm really interested in technology, entrepreneurship, and marketing. I spend quite a lot of time reading and learning about these subjects.   I can build websites with WordPress, run Google Ads campaigns, and lately I've been experimenting a lot with AI-assisted development and vibe coding.    My problem is that I feel like I have knowledge and experience in several different areas, but I haven't managed to turn any of it into a business that can actually grow and scale.    To be honest, I never really liked accounting. It was a family business that I continued mostly because it was already there.   Anyone working in accounting probably understands how exhausting it can be, especially with constantly changing regulations, government requirements, deadlines, and responsibilities.   The stress-to-income ratio just doesn't seem worth it anymore. It also takes up a significant amount of my time and mental energy.
